items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I made some recording with him, I think. No, but Sissy. What do you want with him? Some records with Sisley? Sisley.

ctx.x: Not in any of the details.

Well, I was there when it happened and he had to leave and I had to bring that up, but it's the truth anyway. The truth can be put on that. It's living. And when he came back, he, ten years after that, he came back and he, when he went, when he got out and I wanted to help him. He said, if you need anything, just let me know. And he never forget that he saw that. I really meant to be in his corner and be his friend. You know? And that's why he received me when he came back. Oh, yeah. Ten years after. I never…
Sisley. Yeah. No, not with Sidney. Oh, I thought Sidney was a good one. I was a good one. I was a good one.
